response.sql:
WITH scope_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
mean_of_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as overall_mean
  FROM scope_averages
)
SELECT 
  sa.acctscope as scope,
  sa.avg_net_fee_rate,
  sa.count,
  sa.avg_net_fee_rate - ma.overall_mean as deviation_from_mean
FROM scope_averages sa
CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages ma
ORDER BY sa.acctscope

assumptions.assumption: "how far that average sits from the simple mean of the scope averages" is interpreted as the signed difference (potentially negative) between each scope's average net fee rate and the unweighted arithmetic mean of all scope-level averages.

alternatives.interpretation: If "how far" should represent absolute distance rather than signed deviation, replace the deviation_from_mean expression with ABS(sa.avg_net_fee_rate - ma.overall_mean).
